title: Caramelised Onion and Brie Tray Pizza with Toasted Almonds
changes_from_base: A soft semolina crust baked in one large tray replaces the round thin base, topped with slowly caramelised onions finished with cider vinegar and sugar, cubes of brie, plenty of black pepper and flaked almonds instead of tomato sauce and mozzarella.
summary: Generous sheet pizza topped with a glossy, sweet-savoury layer of caramelised onions and melting brie, scattered with crunchy flaked almonds.
equipment: rimmed baking tray, about 33 x 45 cm

ingredients.note: 55 ml for the dough, 15 ml for the tray

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Make Dough
steps.text: Mix and knead water (340 ml), flour (390 g), semolina (165 g), oil (55 ml), baking powder (1 tbsp), yeast (2 tsp) and salt (1½ tsp) by hand or with a mixer into a smooth, shiny, slightly tacky dough, cover and rise 45-60 min.

steps.title: Cook Onions
steps.text: Heat oil or butter (10 ml) in a frying pan over medium-high, add onions (4 large, 900 g sliced) and cook, stirring often, about 20 min until soft and browning at the edges, add vinegar (1 tbsp), sugar (1 tbsp) and salt (¼ tsp), cook about 10 min more until deep golden and dry, spread on a plate to cool.

steps.title: Oil Tray
steps.text: Oil the tray (33 x 45 cm), press the dough out to fill it (rest 10-15 min if it springs back), cover and leave up to 60 min whilst the onions cool.

steps.title: Build Topping
steps.text: Spread the onions over, scatter brie (425 g cubed), grind pepper (½ tsp) over and add almonds (55 g flaked) if using.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake 20-25 min until golden at the edges and bubbling.

steps.title: Cool and Serve
steps.text: Cool 5-10 min, lift out of the tray and slice.

tips: Keep stirring the onions and give them the full 30 min; rushing leaves them pale and sharp rather than deep golden and sweet.
The dough can rise whilst the onions cool, so you can work at a relaxed pace with minimal active hands-on time
safety: Leave out the almonds for a nut-free pizza; if anyone eating is pregnant, choose a pasteurised brie.
storage: Cool completely, then keep chilled for up to 2 days and reheat gently in a foil-covered tin in a low oven until warmed through. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
